title: Order tracking and expected delivery
text: Share only the carrier status, current location, and promised delivery date shown in the tracking record. If the tracking record has no promised date, do not invent one.

title: Delayed shipment and follow-up
text: Typical client delivery takes 4–7 days and may take longer in the northeast. Transit duration alone does not confirm a delay. When the carrier's expected date has passed, acknowledge the missed estimate and flag the case for a teammate to check the latest update. A carrier estimate is not a guaranteed date. Do not invent compensation or claim that a follow-up has already been assigned.

title: Cancellation needs a teammate
text: The client brief does not specify cancellation eligibility or approved cancellation instructions. Ask a support teammate to check the order system and confirm the merchant's policy. Do not say the order has been cancelled, advise refusing a parcel, or promise a refund.

title: Return or exchange request
text: The client brief says returns are collected and inspected at the fulfillment center, with refunds issued after inspection. It does not specify a return window or order eligibility. Acknowledge the request and ask a support teammate to confirm eligibility before making any commitment. Do not invent a return window, a refund date, or a customer application flow.
